---
title: "concordance-990pf.csv: the 990-PF database"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("_preview.R")
```

The concordance of the **990-PF research database**: the Form 990-PF xpaths,
the return header shared with the 990 and Schedule B, with the 990-PF
mappings of shared xpaths, in the v1 column layout. This page is built from
the package with `concordance("v1", form = "F990PF")`, the same call that
writes `concordance-990pf.csv` at the root of the
[repository](https://github.com/Nonprofit-Open-Data-Collective/concordance990),
so the table and the download always match the package. The full concordance
is [concordance.csv](concordance-csv.html).

The variables are described in the
[990-PF data dictionary](data-dictionary-990pf.html). R users can skip the
file: `concordance990::concordance(form = "F990PF")` returns the same table.

**Using the table.** Search matches any of the 24 columns, and the chips filter by form. Click a label to see the other columns of that xpath. Click a variable name to open its validation page. *Download matching rows* saves only the rows that match the search and filter.

```{r table, results = "asis"}
cat(preview_page(form = "F990PF", file = "concordance-990pf.csv"))
```
